applies_to: Accuenergy AcuRev 1310 series (1312/1313/1314) DIN-rail meters, Modbus map workbook revision 1.1.
summary: The AcuRev 1310 series are Accuenergy's DIN-rail power and energy meters with an RS-485 port that speaks Modbus RTU (or BACnet MS/TP). This map covers the float real-time block (currents, voltages, frequency, power, power factor, phase angles), the demand and neutral/residual block, per-phase and per-tariff energy counters, the meter status words and the dual-source energy feature. The SunSpec mirror blocks, peak-demand timestamps, monthly history and max/min logs in the same workbook are not repeated.

addressing.note: The workbook states that its addresses are 0-based Modbus PDU addresses and prints each as hex and decimal (2000H = 8192). Request the decimal value as given.

source.title: AcuRev 1310 Modbus Register Map (XLSX)
source.pages: Sheets: Data Types (byte/word order, addressing), Real-time Parameters, Energy Reading, Meter Status, Dual Source Energy

notes: The Data Types sheet states high byte first within a register and the high-order register first for 32-bit values, so floats and 32-bit counters are ABCD.
Energy counters are 32-bit integers in Wh, varh or VAh as labelled (revision 1.1 added these units); they can be written (function 16) to preset them.
Function codes per block: 03 to read, 16 to write energy, dual-source settings and commands.

Left out: the SunSpec blocks at 1000H and C350H (scaled duplicates of the same values), monthly energy history, peak-demand values with 6-byte timestamps, demand-reset/unseal/event records, max/min logs, and the dual-source change log records (packed timestamps).
Register 0100H returns a wiring-check result code; the code list is referenced in the maker's map but not reproduced here.

Transport and the 1312/1313/1314 model names come from the AcuRev 1310 user manual (https://www.accuenergy.com/wp-content/uploads/AcuRev-1310-User-Manual.pdf): Modbus RTU (factory default) or BACnet MS/TP on the built-in RS-485 port; no Modbus TCP.

integration.summary: Read the float block 2000H-2045H (8192-8261) for live values and the Int32 energy block 2046H-2085H for kWh-type counters; everything is big-endian, high word first.
integration.enable: Set the Modbus address and serial (or network) parameters on the meter; the workbook does not list the factory communication defaults.
quirks: Energy counters are signed Int32 even though import/export totals only count up; net counters can go negative.
Load type is a float holding an ASCII code (67, 76 or 82).
setup: See the AcuRev 1310 user manual for the front-panel communication settings.
gotchas: Energy registers are writable; a mistaken write with function 16 overwrites the counter.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
